# Markus Walker

> AI engineer based in Brisbane, Australia. I scope, build and deploy AI solutions end to end: agents, the knowledge they work from and the controls around them. Grounded in thirteen years across cybersecurity, IT infrastructure and operational technology.

Clearance: eligible for NV1 and NV2.

## Profile

- [Résumé and portfolio](https://www.markuswalker.com/): experience, projects, writing and capabilities
- [Résumé PDF](https://www.markuswalker.com/Markus_Walker_Resume.pdf): two-page résumé
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/markus-walker-au/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/markus-doc)

## What I do

- Take agentic AI from scoping with the client through architecture, build, security controls and handover.
- Build security in from the first design decision: AI threat modelling, secure software development, MCP governance, access boundaries and control assessment.
- Build knowledge bases agents can reason over, with provenance and human review over what counts as true.
- Platforms I work with include Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, MCP and n8n, with Python, TypeScript and PowerShell.

## Projects

Each project has its own page and was accurate at the time of writing. Index: https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/

- [Ask the Atlas: an interactive questionnaire over the knowledge base](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/ask-the-atlas/): an interactive questionnaire over a sample of the Offerings Atlas that shows how it walks the knowledge base to a cited answer (October 2026). [Try it](https://checkableai.com/stack-check/)
- [The Offerings Atlas: mapping what 166 AI platforms cover, and what they don't](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/offerings-atlas/): a knowledge base of AI agent security controls across 151 platforms and tools that agents research, verify and keep current, with checkable provenance and an enterprise questionnaire (October 2026). [Full text](https://www.markuswalker.com/assets/docs/Markus_Walker_Offerings_Atlas)
- [A local gateway for headless Claude and Codex](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/llm-gateway/): a personal LiteLLM gateway that routes agent calls to headless Claude Code and Codex on my own subscriptions, with JSON-schema output and a proof record per call (October 2026). [Full text](https://www.markuswalker.com/assets/docs/Markus_Walker_LLM_Gateway)
- [Building a governed AI agent on an open knowledge base](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/governed-ai-agent/): a custom AI agent that runs in the cloud, draws everything it knows from an open knowledge base and can only act inside policy written as code (September 2026). [Full text](https://www.markuswalker.com/assets/docs/Markus_Walker_Governed_AI_Agent)
- [Securing Claude Cowork: controls, gaps and safer defaults](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/claude-cowork-controls-cheat-sheet/): what the Claude Cowork admin console, device policy and third-party deployments control, and where they fall short. Version 1.4, evidence cut 23 September 2026. [Full text](https://www.markuswalker.com/assets/docs/Markus_Walker_Cowork_Controls_Cheat_Sheet_v1.4)
- [Human, script or AI? Spotting AI-driven attacks in the SOC](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/distinguishing-ai-driven-attacks/): SOC advisory white paper. Version 5, evidence cut 23 September 2026. [Full text](https://www.markuswalker.com/assets/docs/Markus_Walker_AI_Driven_Attacks_White_Paper_v5)
- [Runner: Claude study game](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/runner-claude-study-game/): pixel-art side-scroller built to study for the Claude Certified Architect, Foundations exam, with question terminals, boss fights and timed mock exams (July to September 2026). [Play](https://www.markuswalker.com/runner/)
- [AI and MCP access governance](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/mcp-access-governance/): portfolio proof of concept for structured review of AI agent integrations and MCP-connected tools (May to July 2026)
- [RESYNTH](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/resynth/): open-source pipeline that consolidates several AI deep-research reports into one verified master document (June 2026)
- [AWS security architecture case study](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/aws-security-architecture-case-study/): fictional planning case study (April 2026)
- [Incident response planning portfolio](https://www.markuswalker.com/projects/incident-response-planning/): structured around NIST SP 800-61 (April 2026)
